title: Widespread Hyper-Coupling and Frequency-Specific Dysregulation of Phase-Amplitude Coupling in Young Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder.
abstract: Resting-state EEG in 237 children with ASD aged 3-9 and 201 age-matched typically developing children. Analysis examined low-frequency oscillation phase (delta, theta, alpha) modulation of high-frequency oscillation amplitude (beta, low gamma) at intra-region and inter-region scalp levels, quantified by modulation index with Bonferroni correction. ASD showed enhanced delta/theta/alpha-gamma coupling across measured scalp regions, increased delta-beta coupling in frontal, temporal and occipital regions, and reduced alpha-beta coupling in frontal and central regions. Elevated PAC strength in delta/theta/alpha-gamma bands correlated negatively with Autism Behavior Checklist scores.
